paragraphs.source_en: The primary insight of the second superstring revolution is summarized by Figures 12. 1 and 12. 2. In Figure 12. 1 we see the situation prior to the recent ability to go (partially) beyond the approximation methods physicists have traditionally used to analyze string theory. We see that the five string theories were thought of as being completely separate. But, with the newfound insights emerging from recent research, as indicated in Figure 12. 2, we see that, like the starfish’s five arms, all of the string theories are now viewed as a single, all-encompassing framework.
